title: OSSP: Update ESMC dissection to match current recommendation
description:
Update ESMC dissection to ITU-T G.8264/Y.1364 (2017)/Amd.1 (03/2018)
- Replace timestamp TLV by Extended QL TLV
- Create interpretation of SSM+eSSM to derive QL
- Allow regional option selection I and II (prepare for III)
- Try to keep backward compatible ossp.esmc.ql field
- Remove superfluous error reporting, let expert info do the talking

Clean up OSSP dissection code

Closes #17491
